title: Fix MDX syntax error in plugin-chatbot.mdx
body:
Turbopack build was failing on `plugin-chatbot.mdx` due to invalid JSX attribute syntax at line 37.

## Changes

- Fixed JSX prop syntax: `description: "..."` → `description="..."`

```diff
  <InteractiveDemo
    schema={{...}}
    title="Basic Chatbot"
-   description: "Simple chat interface with auto-response enabled"
+   description="Simple chat interface with auto-response enabled"
  />
```

The colon syntax is valid inside JavaScript objects but not for JSX attributes.
